source: Dream Plastic, AX DESIGN PLAN & METHOD REV.1 (DPAI 확장판 교육, 2025-12-30), 113 pages. Page numbers are 1-based PDF pages.

principles.photo_is_ground_truth: Approved multi-view images derived from the original photo define appearance. The AI GLB is a reference for part partition intent only.
principles.editable_before_moldable: Moldable is derived from an approved Editable snapshot (hash-bound); it is never generated from scratch.
principles.every_part_closed: Every separated part in Editable AND Moldable must be a closed 2-manifold solid.
principles.no_silent_pass: Empty lists, timeouts and missing evidence never count as PASS.
principles.ai_is_advisor: Astra proposes (split judgements, joint concepts, images). Geometry is changed only by Blender / manifold3d and re-verified.

gates.rule: open_edges == 0, nonmanifold_edges == 0, degenerate_faces == 0, winding consistent, volume > 0 for EVERY part
each part is one connected shell (Blender Select Linked unit) unless explicitly declared
split review decisions (merge / resplit_clean / keep) are human-approved and applied by Blender
silhouette IoU against every approved photo view >= photo_silhouette_min_iou
BVH non-adjacent triangle overlap screen == 0 pairs (screen, not exact proof)
quad ratio >= min_quad_ratio; triangulated GLB face count is not an editability measure
Blender OBJ export -> reimport keeps part names, face counts and closure
units mm, Y-up public / Z-up Blender, export scale 1
7M-12M quads is a high-poly EXAMPLE, 30M max; p.109 '1M(1천만)' is ambiguous. Report only; never inflate faces to pass.
Real ZBrush import -> partial sculpt -> save -> reopen. Human evidence only; NOT_VERIFIED by default.

actions.merge: Fragments of one semantic region (same cape, same eye) split into several patches -> one part.
actions.resplit_clean: Legitimate semantic boundary but jagged / zig-zag -> keep two parts, smooth the boundary.
actions.keep: Boundary is a real design boundary and already clean.

split_review.note: Editable 'separation (분리)' is for editing; Moldable 'partition (분할)' is for manufacturing (p.18). Do not confuse them.

assumptions: max_undercut_area_ratio values are demo screening thresholds chosen by the developer, NOT numbers from the PDF. Replace with mold-engineer values.

PVC_ROTO.undercut_tolerance: relaxed (PVC pulled off the ROTO mold)

gates.rule: moldable input hash == approved editable geometry hash
same as editable
every contact interface of the moldable partition has exactly one approved joint plan or an approved merge
every joint: male pin unioned into its body, female socket cut with clearance, boss/wall intact
pairwise positive-volume intersection == 0 in assembled state
full-interval straight insertion sweep along the joint axis has no positive-volume collision
sampled inward ray thickness p05 >= material min_wall_mm (tips may reach 1.02 mm only locally)
report thick/thin ratio; abrupt changes cause sink marks and cracks
ABS only: solid thickness > 5 mm requires an extra split
best two-sided pull direction undercut area ratio <= material limit
area ratio of faces nearly parallel to the pull direction (< 0.5 deg) is reported
protruding tips: local thickness >= 1.5 mm main, >= 1.02 mm extreme; tips must be rounded
center of mass projects inside the support polygon; otherwise base / pose change
a flat bottom area >= 7 mm (normally 10-12 mm) for the legal line
flag parts that fit a small-parts cylinder (31.7 mm dia; external standard 16 CFR 1501, not in the PDF)
joint archetype/dimensions retrieved from the analysed S3 reference library; NOT_VERIFIED while the library is empty
print / copycast / mold engineer approval. Human only; never automated.

joint_defaults_assumption.note: Used only while the S3 joint library is empty. These are demo assumptions, not approved tolerances.

numbers_with_context.p38: Sharp point main min 1.5 mm, stable >= 2 mm, pillar average > 2.3 mm, extreme tip ~1.02 mm locally. Context: tip regions, not a universal wall rule.
numbers_with_context.p42: ABS structure thicker than 5 mm -> split. ABS injection only.
numbers_with_context.p44: Case clearance 7-10 mm: packaging case study.
numbers_with_context.p47: Hand to face >= 6 mm or insert blister: paint chipping case.
numbers_with_context.p48: Legal line 7-14 mm (normally 10-12 mm): buyer/marking dependent.
numbers_with_context.p78: 107% wax mock-up: ROTO process example; not a universal shrink factor.
numbers_with_context.p84: 7-12M quads average, 30M max: high-poly budget example, not a minimum.
numbers_with_context.p109: '1M (1천만)' mismatch between M and Korean number; do not auto-threshold.
